adviceLabel.zh: 持续停码时的排查参考

zh: 内存训练可能持续数分钟。结合完整代码序列、停留时间、KVM/串口画面及事件日志判断；短暂出现某个码不等于故障。
本项目 BF 表示 MRC 开始/结束，AF 表示 ExitBootServices 检查点。E8 等码在 AMI 与 Intel MRC 中可能含义不同，阶段未确定时不强行归类。
Port 80h 是采集端口。单个字节不能还原 85xx 错误、MRC 子码或完整 FSP 码，也不能确定 DIMM 槽位。排查前先导出日志，修改硬件前断开 AC 电源。
en: Memory training can take several minutes. Compare the full sequence, elapsed time, KVM or serial output and event logs. A briefly displayed code alone does not establish a failure.
For this project, BF is MRC start/stop and AF is an ExitBootServices checkpoint. Codes such as E8 differ between AMI and Intel MRC; an unknown phase must remain unclassified.
Port 80h is the capture port. One byte cannot reconstruct an 85xx error, MRC subcode, full FSP code or DIMM slot. Export logs before troubleshooting; disconnect AC before changing hardware.

memory.zh: 先等待内存训练完成；若长时间无进展，核对支持的 DIMM 类型及插槽顺序。断开 AC 后按主板要求用最小内存配置和已知良好的 DIMM 排查，并对照串口与事件日志定位。
memory.en: Allow memory training to finish. If progress stalls, check supported DIMM types and population order. With AC disconnected, isolate using the board-required minimum configuration and known-good memory; correlate serial output and event logs.

nvram.zh: 检查近期 BIOS 设置变更。若厂商流程要求恢复默认或清 CMOS，先记录自定义设置；仅凭此码不能确定是电池或 NVRAM 损坏。
nvram.en: Review recent BIOS setting changes. Record custom settings before following a vendor procedure to load defaults or clear CMOS. This checkpoint alone does not prove a battery or NVRAM fault.

pcie.zh: 检查近期新增的 PCIe 设备、固件与资源配置；断开 AC 后逐一减少扩展卡，用最小配置对比启动结果。
pcie.en: Review newly added PCIe devices, firmware and resource settings. With AC disconnected, reduce add-in cards one at a time and compare boot behavior with a minimum configuration.

usb.zh: 检查 USB 设备及虚拟媒体是否响应。保存当前信息后，在不影响正在进行的安装或升级时减少非必要 USB 设备并重新观察。
usb.en: Check whether USB devices and virtual media respond. Preserve diagnostics, then reduce nonessential USB devices when doing so will not interrupt an installation or update.

storage.zh: 核对存储设备识别、连接和启动顺序；该参考码属于传统 IDE/SATA 检测，不能直接据此判定 NVMe 故障。
storage.en: Check storage detection, connections and boot order. This reference checkpoint concerns legacy IDE/SATA detection and does not by itself identify an NVMe failure.

optionRom.zh: 检查 HBA、RAID、网卡等扩展卡的 Option ROM 与启动配置；对照厂商兼容性说明逐项排除，先记录原设置。
optionRom.en: Review Option ROM and boot settings for add-in cards such as HBA, RAID and network adapters. Record existing settings and isolate devices using vendor compatibility guidance.

boot.zh: 检查启动设备、引导程序以及后续 KVM/串口输出。到达引导交接检查点不代表操作系统已成功启动。
boot.en: Check the selected boot device, boot loader and subsequent KVM or serial output. Reaching a boot handoff checkpoint does not prove that the operating system started successfully.
